# scripts/Combat/ViewPoses.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/ViewPoses.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Camera-space weapon poses: [grip: Vector3, blade: Vector3, edge: Vector3].
Positions use metres, +X right, +Y up, -Z ahead. Blade models use +Y along
the blade and +X along its true edge; bow poses use [grip, up, shooting].

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

### sweep_frame

```gdscript
static func sweep_frame(spec: Dictionary, u: float, charged := 0.0) -> Transform3D
```

[Source:170](../../../../../scripts/Combat/ViewPoses.gd#L170)

Where a sweep has the weapon, `u` from 0 (drawn back) through 0.5 (the
blade meeting what it cuts) to 1 (followed through); `charged` 0..1 draws
it further back first. The fist runs a smooth curve through the sweep's
path; the blade points out along the reach (from the pivot the body turns
about), running behind it (`lead` < 0) or ahead (> 0) by degrees, and
rising by `rise`; its true edge faces the way it is travelling.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `spec` | `Dictionary` | required |
| `u` | `float` | required |
| `charged` | `inferred from default` | `0.0` |

Return type: `Transform3D`.
